name: @lingjing-agent/mcp
description: MCP client bridge + server side for @lingjing-agent/core — bridge an external MCP server's tools into core Tools (createMcpTools), or expose core Tools as an MCP server (createMcpServer). Hand-rolled JSON-RPC (legacy initialize era, tools only), zero deps. Cross-runtime entry (HTTP over core HttpTransport); both stdio halves via "@lingjing-agent/mcp/node" (client transport + server channel, Node only).
